notes: Partition checked: 16 source morphemes, 26 target tokens, each used once.

*did some remain* keeps *some* with the verb as the pronoun realizing its person and number (rule 17); the competing reading marks it `added` as a supplied subject, but rule 17's exclusion names a lexical subject noun (*men shall dwell therein*) and *some* carries no lexeme of its own.

*There was none of the Anakim left*: the negation recast as a determiner goes to לֹא (rule 15), the presentative frame to נוֹתַר (rule 17), and the supplied partitive *of the* to the nominal it stands before (rules 15, 33).
